fields.text: Upload a short clip; Crystal Video Upscaler (`clarity-ai/crystal-video-upscaler`) makes a sharper, larger target-megapixel output. Pin target_megapixels=1 in modelOpts ($0.10/MP/s, min $0.10). First-click story is a matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio clip with one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron — no committed clip in-repo. Not still upscale (P-Image Upscale) and not a camera-orbit generate (Night-ride radio orbit / Omni Flash turntable).
